wins: Established initial network overview through automated nmap scan, identifying live hosts and essential service ports.
Captured consistent reconnaissance artifacts enabling construction of prioritized target list for follow-on actions.
fails: Failed to escalate privileges due to absence of valid credentials and overlooked sudo paths, leaving post-exploitation phase incomplete.
Repeatedly triggered IDS signatures during brute-forcing attempts, resulting in timeouts and limited access opportunities.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance delivered actionable target visibility, but execution stalled during exploitation/privilege escalation, yielding no successful compromises across the single episode.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts consistently failed when relying solely on default sudo paths without validating sudo rights or exploiting misconfigured binaries.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with 200 OK and directory listing absent
skill_cards.then_action: Invoke gobuster for directory brute force against common wordlists

skill_cards.if_condition: When sudo privileges appear disabled for current user
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate sudoers and seek setuid binaries before brute force escalation

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in extracting SSH configuration details during reconnaissance.

next_experiments.title: Credential validation prior to privilege escalation
next_experiments.description: Script execution that validates sudo permissions and identifies writable configuration files before running exploitation attempts, reducing lockouts and false negatives.

next_experiments.title: Stealthy HTTP enumeration
next_experiments.description: Shift from aggressive gobuster scans to smaller wordlists combined with timing adjustments and randomized requests to avoid IDS tripping during directory enumeration.

next_experiments.title: Post-recon pivot automation
next_experiments.description: Implement chaining of discovered SMB shares and HTTP endpoints into a unified attack plan to quickly transition from scanning to exploitation once valid credentials found.
